headline: iPhone Air 2 reportedly lands next spring with second camera
summary: Apple may launch iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027 with a second rear camera, improved battery life, and A20 Pro processor.
details: Apple is reportedly planning to launch a follow-up to the iPhone Air, introduced last fall, with a potential release in spring 2027. The new device, iPhone Air 2, might feature a second rear camera, improved battery life, and a version of the A20 Pro processor.

The original iPhone Air was viewed as a precursor to Apple's eventual foldable smartphone, but it was not a big seller. Despite this, Apple may have higher aspirations for this ultralight form factor as a permanent part of its mobile lineup.

The iPhone Air 2 would alleviate some tradeoffs needed for its slim chassis, such as the solitary rear camera, which was seen as a downside in reviews. A spring release would confirm Apple's shift in product calendar, following the announcement of the budget iPhone 17e in the spring.
caption:
Is Apple planning a new iPhone Air 2 for spring 2027?

Apple is reportedly planning to launch a follow-up to the iPhone Air, introduced last fall, with a potential release in spring 2027. The new device, iPhone Air 2, might feature a second rear camera, improved battery life, and a version of the A20 Pro processor.

The original iPhone Air was viewed as a precursor to Apple's eventual foldable smartphone, but it was not a big seller. Despite this, Apple may have higher aspirations for this ultralight form factor as a permanent part of its mobile lineup.

The iPhone Air 2 would alleviate some tradeoffs needed for its slim chassis, such as the solitary rear camera, which was seen as a downside in reviews. A spring release would confirm Apple's shift in product calendar, following the announcement of the budget iPhone 17e in the spring.
